---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a capability or improvement
labels: enhancement
---

### The problem

What you are trying to do that is currently hard or impossible. Describe the
situation rather than the solution — the best fix is often not the one first
imagined.

### Proposed solution

What you would like to see. API sketch or example usage if you have one.

### Alternatives considered

Workarounds you tried, and why they are not enough.

### Who this affects

Just you, or a class of consumers? A breaking change to an existing behaviour, or
purely additive?

### Additional context

Links to related issues, upstream documentation, or a Jira ticket if one exists.
